preambles.text: Unless an elderly patient’s clinical status is end-of-life and therefore requiring a more palliative focus of pharmacotherapy, the following drug therapies should be considered where omitted for no valid clinical reason(s).
It is assumed that the prescriber observes all the specific contraindications to these drug therapies prior to recommending them to older patients.
